remarks: Completely renovated with custom features & details! This spacious 1 bedroom, 1 bath apartment comes with a bonus room that could be used as a junior bedroom or home office. 1 assigned garage parking spot #14 included (no separate fee). Heat, hot water + water is also included in the monthly rent! Open floor plan. Hardwood floors. Equipped galley kitchen with plenty of cabinetry & stainless steel appliances (dishwasher, microwave, gas oven & large refrigerator). A trendy barn sliding door opens to the private bonus room. Custom hallway closet with built-ins and shelving. The primary bedroom is spacious & has a large custom walk-in closet which includes shelving & a built in dresser. Updated full bathroom with large shower/tub combo & fabulous premium rainfall shower faucet. Laundry room on each floor. Sorry, no pets. Tenant pays electricity. Located in the trendy Springdale Village - walk to train, restaurants, shops and more! Hyde Park is a well-maintained hi-rise building with an elevator. Available now!
